statistical_significance: Study 1 table reports p<0.0001 for both fixed doses. Study 2 table reports p=0.0007, while its narrative says p<0.0001. Study 3 primary endpoint p<0.0001.
safety: Label includes somnolence and sudden onset of sleep, orthostatic hypotension, hallucinations, impulse-control disorders and dyskinesia.
rationale: Controlled Phase 3 trials support functional benefit in early and adjunctive treatment. The FDA approval was known when this assessment was recorded.
evidence_gaps: Durability and uncommon harms beyond the controlled study periods
